Name: No More Dry Under the Bridge.
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=4]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

[size=3]Improved mountain landscape, with a stream added beneath the bridge.
[/size][size=3]You can go near the water, fish for mountain fish, and you can place crab pots.
It's compatible with all recolors.
I only added those tiles, just enough to be able to add a stream, but I tried to modify the map as little as possible, so it should be compatible with almost everything.
If you want to know if it's compatible with "insert mod here," you can test it yourself. It won't break the game.
It only requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.
To install, open the zip and copy the folder into the Stardew Valley Mods folder.
To uninstall, simply delete the folder.
[/size]
[size=3]Enjoy!

[color=#00ffff]Thank you all for your support! <3[/color]

Maybe you might be interested in my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/181358142?tab=user+files]Mods[/url]

If you like what I do and want to buy me a cup of coffee, you can do so here: [url=https://ko-fi.com/kanacane]Ko fi[/url]

Here is my Discord server. https://discord.gg/PEHYyagv6T[/size]
